label: Global EV Battery Demand (H1 2026)
deltaNote: Global EV battery installations reached 608.5 GWh in H1 2026, up 20% YoY. CATL led with 242.7 GWh (39.9% share), extending its lead even as Chinese makers as a group face intensifying non-China competition — CATL's global ESS (grid storage) share held at 27.1% in H1 2026 as non-China storage markets overtook China in installed volume for the first time.

label: Avg. Battery Pack Price
deltaNote: BNEF year-end 2025 global average across all pack types; BEV-specific packs at ~$99/kWh; grid storage packs as low as $70/kWh. Rising metal prices in H2 2025 moderated decline vs. earlier projections.

label: CATL Global EV Battery Market Share (H1 2026)
deltaNote: CATL held 39.9% of the global EV battery market in H1 2026 with 242.7 GWh installed, out of 608.5 GWh installed globally (+20% YoY). CATL separately reported it shipped 125.0 GWh into the grid-storage (ESS) market in H1 2026 (+81% YoY), lifting its ESS share to 27.1% even as non-China ESS markets overtook China in installed volume for the first time.

label: Lithium Carbonate (China spot, USD equiv.)
source: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence / Carbon Credits, Sep 24, 2026
deltaNote: After the Aug 24 single-session spike to ~$24,086/tonne (~¥160,500) on energy-storage demand, lithium carbonate gave back most of the gain, falling ~18% to ~$19,830/tonne by Sep 24, 2026. The retreat tracks fading supply-disruption premium from CATL's Jianxiawo mine (China's largest lithium deposit, idled since an early-August environmental-permit revocation) alongside cooling near-term EV demand growth.

label: Best Solid-State Energy Density (production-stage)
source: Ganfeng Lithium small-batch production (May 2026); ProLogium Gen 3.5 mass production, TÜV-verified (Sep 2026)
contestNote: Ganfeng's 500 Wh/kg cell remains the highest at production stage but only at dozens–hundreds of cells/day. ProLogium began Giga-level mass production of its Gen 3.5 all-solid-state Lithium Ceramic Battery in Taiwan in September 2026 — a lower 381 Wh/kg (903 Wh/L) but the first all-solid-state cell independently verified (TÜV, UL) at true mass-manufacturing scale rather than pilot/small-batch volume. Li Auto separately said (Sep 22, 2026) it targets only small-batch solid-state vehicle integration by 2027–2028, with mature mass production not expected until 2032–2033 — underscoring that scale-up, not peak lab energy density, is now the binding constraint.

label: Sodium-Ion Global Output / Pipeline
value: 65+ GWh ordered; Hina matches Tesla cell quality
source: CATL/HyperStrong + CATL/Alfen (Jul 16, 2026); Hina/Cell Reports Physical Science (Jun 21, 2026)
delta: CATL's first Europe sodium-ion BESS deployment now confirmed (5 GWh, Alfen, from 2027)
deltaNote: CATL signed a 5 GWh TENER Sodium storage deal with Dutch integrator Alfen on July 16, 2026 — the first planned sodium-ion BESS deployment in Europe — adding to its 60 GWh HyperStrong domestic order. Separately, peer-reviewed research published Jun 21 found Chinese maker Hina's sodium-ion cells, using a tabless double-aluminum current collector design, now match Tesla's lithium-ion cells on manufacturing quality and performance — a notable validation of sodium-ion's production maturity, not just its cost story.

label: Fastest EV Battery Charging Rate (announced)
source: CATL Qilin 3 (3rd-gen) — CATL Tech Day, Apr 21, 2026
contestNote: CATL Tech Day announcement; production vehicle qualification ongoing with three unnamed OEMs for 2027. Requires ~1,000 kW charger infrastructure not yet widely deployed. 3rd-gen Shenxing LFP achieves 10-80% in 3m44s. Real-world rates will be constrained by charging network capacity.
deltaNote: CATL's 1st-gen Shenxing (2024) achieved 4C; Qilin 3 claims 10C continuous with 3,000 kW output — enabling ~400 km recovered in under 5 minutes. Targets 1,000+ km WLTP range in premium vehicle platform. If achieved commercially, eliminates fast-charging as an EV objection.
